title: Align a TSV table for the terminal
notes: skill: write a stdin->stdout TSV table formatter (numeric/text alignment, decimal padding, code-point widths, empty-cell placeholder, rule line), run on hidden tables; traps: non-ASCII widths (byte-based awk misaligns), decimal padding, a numeric-looking column with one text cell, short rows, grouped thousands (knob); pass_guess_permille: 450
